blocks.title: Deployment
blocks.text: Jab software achi tarah test ho jaye aur masail theek ho jayein to woh deployment mein jata hai: software ko users ke liye istemal ke qabil aur dastiyab banana.

items: Installation: software user ke system ya server par install hota hai, aksar installation program chala kar jo files copy aur settings tay karta hai.
Configuration: software ko user ya idare ki zarooraton ke mutabiq dhaala jata hai, jaise user ki pasand, network settings aur database connections.
Asal duniya mein testing: install ke baad software apne asal mahaul mein test hota hai ta ke doosre nizamon ke saath chale aur user ki zarooratein poori kare.

blocks.text: Software deploy karna nayi dukaan kholne jaisa hai: sab kuch tayyar hone par aap customers (users) ko apna product istemal karne ke liye khushamdeed kehte hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Deployment mein install ke baad software dobara kyun test hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke asal mahaul development ke mahaul se mukhtalif hota hai: software ko jaanchna zaroori hai ke user ke doosre nizamon, settings aur data ke saath chale aur amalan users ki zarooratein poori kare.

items: Deployment: test shuda software users ke liye dastiyab karna.
Qadam: installation, configuration, asal duniya mein testing; nayi dukaan kholne jaisa.
